items.summary: The Indian rupee has shown remarkable strength, breaking the 93 per dollar barrier for the first time since April. This positive shift was fueled by impressive foreign portfolio investments, exceeding $12 billion in November alone. Consequently, the rupee has left its Asian peers behind as it thrives against a strong dollar, all while navigating the Federal Reserve's anticipated hawkish stance, showcasing an encouraging signal for the Indian market.

items.title: Nvidia faces talent exodus risk after Jensen Huang's exit: Can the chipmaker retain engineers behind its AI dominance?
items.summary: Nvidia faces a potential talent exodus after Jensen Huang's departure, with rivals expected to poach its engineers. Interim CEO Colette Kress has promised early pay raises and stock grants to retain key employees, but questions remain over their long-term loyalty.

items.title: Apple loses the man behind the iPhone camera
items.summary: Jon McCormack retired from Apple after over eight years as head of camera and photo software. His departure involves significant changes, impacting the leadership of Apple's camera technology. McCormack played a crucial role in developing key iPhone photography features, which are essential for marketing. The camera and photos teams will now report to Sebastien Marineau-Mes, who previously oversaw them.

items.title: India's solar cell capacity surge may squeeze margins, favour integrated manufacturers: Report
items.summary: India's solar manufacturing sector is anticipated to shift with a surge in domestic cell production capacity. This increase in capacity could ease supply shortages and influence profit margins among manufacturers. As the sector transitions, execution and financial strength will become critical for success. However, challenges in demand and the impact of US trade duties could affect growth.

items.title: Nike to become Formula One's official apparel and uniform partner
items.summary: Formula One has established a partnership with Nike to become its official apparel and uniform supplier starting in 2027. This collaboration includes co-branded uniforms for event staff, as well as fan apparel and accessories. Nike will also support Formula One's all-female development series, F1 Academy. The partnership will debut with a limited Las Vegas Grand Prix x Nike collection available for fans.

items.summary: India reached a significant achievement by blending 20% ethanol in the 2025-26 marketing year, which ended in October. The milestone indicates progress in renewable energy usage while reducing reliance on fossil fuels. Notably, 74% of the ethanol supply derived from grain-based feedstocks.

items.title: Customs should review classification of bulk Scotch whisky imports: GTRI
items.summary: Customs authorities are facing a tariff dispute regarding bulk Scotch whisky imports following the India-UK trade agreement. The classification issue revolves around whether Scotch falls under specific tariff codes for spirits or food preparations. Importers currently classify bulk Scotch under a code that entitles them to reduced duties. Recent changes have led to customs reclassifying these imports, which doubles the duty rate significantly.

items.title: Piyush Goyal calls for trusted India-US supply chains, deeper economic cooperation
items.summary: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal urged India and the US to build trusted supply chains for better collaboration. He highlighted that India's strengths in talent and manufacturing complement America's capital and technology. The minister also encouraged increased partnerships between educational institutions in both nations. Goyal expressed optimism for achieving USD one trillion in exports during the current fiscal year.

items.title: India needs $430 billion in exports in five months to meet FY27 target: Piyush Goyal
items.summary: India requires approximately USD 430 billion in exports from November to March to meet its ambitious target. By the end of October, the country had achieved 57 percent of its export goal for 2026-27. October exports reached an all-time high of nearly USD 90 billion, which reflects substantial growth. Union Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal proposed a target of USD 1 trillion for this fiscal year.

items.title: CIL-led consortium receives LoI from govt to set up rare earth permanent manufacturing facility
items.summary: Coal India Ltd has received a letter of intent to manufacture rare earth permanent magnets with a capacity of 1,200 tonnes. This project will take place over seven years, with two years for pre-construction and five years for operations. The Union Cabinet approved this initiative in November 2025 as part of a financial outlay of Rs 7,280 crore. Rare earth magnets are vital for industries like electric vehicles and aerospace.

They seek collaboration in sectors such as automotive, aerospace, and agriculture. The discussions took place during the recent India-Italy Joint Commission for Economic Cooperation meeting in Rome. Participants highlighted the importance of investment partnerships and technology sharing for successful outcomes. Both countries aim to integrate into global value chains effectively.

items.title: India-US FTA could strengthen aerospace partnerships, boost business opportunities: Gautam Singhania
items.summary: Gautam Singhania emphasized the potential benefits of the proposed India-US Free Trade Agreement for aerospace partnerships. He noted that his company, Raymond Aerospace, has long-standing relationships with American firms. The 23rd Indo-US Economic Summit facilitated networking opportunities to strengthen commercial ties between both nations. Various industry representatives explored collaboration possibilities that could benefit both sides. Increased cooperation in aerospace could lead to growth in business opportunities through this trade agreement.
